name: Grandma Shorty's Jewish Coffee Cake
author: Grandma Shorty
steps: In a large bowl, cream together the butter, 1 cup of the sugar, eggs, and vanilla until smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the batter.
Make the topping in a separate bowl by combining the remaining 1/2 cup of sugar, cinnamon, and walnuts.
Pour ½ of the batter into a greased angel food or tube pan.
Sprinkle ½ of the topping evenly over the batter.
Add the remaining batter, then sprinkle the remaining topping on top.
Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Allow to cool slightly before serving.
